title: cynanchum grayanum
intro: Cynanchum grayanum, commonly known as the grayanotamin plant, is a type of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cynanchum grayanum include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the management of conditions such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include grayanotoxin, a sesquiterpene lactone that exhibits therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and spasmolytic effects.
